answer: Each agent must stake at the inlet to the mesa relay, where a rotating beacon broadcasts a fresh challenge every epoch; agents must sign it within a tight window or forfeit stake. Sybils minting many identities must fund and maintain stake plus challenge-response hardware per identity, and the beacon's timing randomness makes precomputation costly, so mass fake agents lose money faster than honest ones earn. The Agent0221 deployment anchors trust at Qsih4aEbSV.
